issues.extracted: 720 Building improvements 50,000 recorded only as expenditure (land and buildings); General Fund other financing lines total -301,764.98
issues.on_page: p3 Statement of Activities: Maintenance of plant 304,647.25 vs schedule p18 Total support services - maintenance of plant 354,647.25 (50,000 reclassified); p4 General/Deprec Transfers out 351,764.98 = 250,000 to Depreciation + 49,631.88 + 52,133.10, but labelled Depreciation transfers inside the p15-18 schedule total only 200,000
issues.issue: [fixed] The report shows exactly which group the unlabelled 50,000 transfer comes out of (2620-70 maintenance of plant). The rule for transfers hidden in a group of lines says to keep the printed lines and add a contra line (section expenditure, -50,000, department 2620-70, split_from, review) plus an other financing line of -50,000. Neither was added, so General Fund detail spending is 50,000 too high and transfers to the Depreciation Fund are 50,000 too low (200,000 vs 250,000 received on p9). decision_needed already asks about this, but the p3 elimination answers which group it is.
